description.value: MR MIKES is a Canadian SteakhouseCasual chain with roots dating to 1960, serving premium steaks, burgers, pastas, salads, and shareable appetizers in a relaxed, no-dress-code setting. The Prince George location on Ferry Avenue is a full sit-down restaurant with both dine-in and takeout options, positioning itself as a community gathering spot for locals and travellers alike. A touring cyclist passing through Prince George can expect a substantial hot meal with a casual atmosphere and no stuffed-shirt attitude.

address.value: 2216 Ferry Avenue, Prince George, British Columbia, V2N 0B1, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (2216 Ferry Avenue, Prince George, BC V2N 0B1), phone (250-562-1080), and email (princegeorge@mrmikes.ca). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those are set to null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: OSM name field uses 'Mr Mikes' but the brand's official styling on the website is 'MR MIKES' — minor capitalization discrepancy, not substantive.
